title: Effect of Tronclass combined with team-based learning on nursing students’ self-directed learning and academic performance: a pretest-posttest study
reason: Pre/post self-directed-learning scale scores and comparison of midterm/final grades with a previous graduated cohort after Tronclass plus team-based learning. No per-student Tronclass activity indicator is analysed; only pre-post and cohort contrasts.

extraction.n_quote: One out of 69 Participants dropped out of the program, and data from the rest 68 were collected.
extraction.outcome_or_construct: self-directed learning ability (self-report scale); midterm and final grades
extraction.notes: Secondary: NOREL for the SDL scale (self-report).
